paragraphs.en: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
paragraphs.zh: 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

paragraphs.en: 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物 A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything
paragraphs.zh: 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

paragraphs.en: MiroFish is a next-generation AI prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. By extracting seed information from the real world (such as breaking news, policy drafts, or financial signals), it automatically constructs a high-fidelity parallel digital world. Within this space, thousands of intelligent agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic freely interact and undergo social evolution. You can inject variables dynamically from a "God's-eye view" to precisely deduce future trajectories — rehearse the future in a digital sandbox, and win decisions after countless simulations .
paragraphs.zh: MiroFish 是一个由多智能体技术驱动的下一代 AI 预测引擎。 通过从现实世界中提取种子信息（如突发新闻、政策草案或金融信号），它会自动构建一个高保真的平行数字世界。 在这个空间中，成千上万具有独立人格、长期记忆和行为逻辑的智能体自由交互并进行社会演化。 你可以从「上帝视角」动态注入变量，精准推演未来轨迹——在数字沙盒中预演未来，在无数次模拟后赢得决策。

paragraphs.en: You only need to: Upload seed materials (data analysis reports or interesting novel stories) and describe your prediction requirements in natural language MiroFish will return: A detailed prediction report and a deeply interactive high-fidelity digital world
paragraphs.zh: 你只需要：上传种子素材（数据分析报告或有趣新颖的故事），并用自然语言描述你的预测需求，MiroFish 将返回：一份详细的预测报告以及一个深度交互的高保真数字世界

paragraphs.en: MiroFish is dedicated to creating a swarm intelligence mirror that maps reality. By capturing the collective emergence triggered by individual interactions, we break through the limitations of traditional prediction:
paragraphs.zh: MiroFish 致力于打造一个映射现实的群体智能镜像。 通过捕捉个体交互所引发的集体涌现，我们突破了传统预测的局限：

sents.en: By capturing the collective emergence triggered by individual interactions, we break through the limitations of traditional prediction:

paragraphs.en: From serious predictions to playful simulations, we let every "what if" see its outcome, making it possible to predict anything.
paragraphs.zh: 从严肃的预测到有趣的模拟，我们让每一个“如果”都看到它的结果，使预测一切成为可能。

paragraphs.en: # Copy the example configuration file cp .env.example .env # Edit the .env file and fill in the required API keys Required Environment Variables:
paragraphs.zh: # 复制示例配置文件 cp .env.example .env # 编辑 .env 文件并填写所需的 API 密钥 所需的环境变量：

paragraphs.en: # LLM API Configuration (supports any LLM API with OpenAI SDK format) # Recommended: Alibaba Qwen-plus model via Bailian Platform: https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/ # High consumption, try simulations with fewer than 40 rounds first LLM_API_KEY = your_api_key LLM_BASE_URL = https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 LLM_MODEL_NAME = qwen-plus # Zep Cloud Configuration # Free monthly quota is sufficient for simple usage: https://app.getzep.com/ ZEP_API_KEY = your_zep_api_key 2. Install Dependencies # One-click installation of all dependencies (root + frontend + backend) npm run setup:all Or install step by step:
paragraphs.zh:
# LLM API 配置（支持任何 OpenAI SDK 格式的 LLM API）
# 推荐：通过百炼平台使用阿里通义千问 qwen-plus 模型：https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/
# 消耗较高，建议先进行少于 40 轮的模拟
LLM_API_KEY = your_api_key
LLM_BASE_URL = https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
LLM_MODEL_NAME = qwen-plus

# Zep Cloud 配置
# 免费月度额度足以满足简单使用需求：https://app.getzep.com/
ZEP_API_KEY = your_zep_api_key

2. 安装依赖

# 一键安装所有依赖（根目录 + 前端 + 后端）
npm run setup:all

或者逐步安装：

paragraphs.en: # Install Node dependencies (root + frontend) npm run setup # Install Python dependencies (backend, auto-creates virtual environment) npm run setup:backend 3. Start Services # Start both frontend and backend (run from project root) npm run dev Service URLs:
paragraphs.zh: # 安装 Node 依赖（根目录 + 前端）npm run setup # 安装 Python 依赖（后端，自动创建虚拟环境）npm run setup:backend 3. 启动服务 # 同时启动前端和后端（从项目根目录运行）npm run dev 服务地址：

sents.en: # Install Node dependencies (root + frontend) npm run setup # Install Python dependencies (backend, auto-creates virtual environment) npm run setup:backend 3.
sents.zh: # 安装 Node 依赖（根目录 + 前端）npm run setup # 安装 Python 依赖（后端，自动创建虚拟环境）npm run setup:backend 3.

sents.en: Start Services # Start both frontend and backend (run from project root) npm run dev Service URLs:
sents.zh: 启动服务 # 同时启动前端和后端（从项目根目录运行）npm run dev 服务地址：

paragraphs.en: npm run backend # Start backend only npm run frontend # Start frontend only Option 2: Docker Deployment # 1. Configure environment variables (same as source deployment) cp .env.example .env # 2. Pull image and start docker compose up -d Reads .env from root directory by default, maps ports 3000 (frontend) / 5001 (backend)
paragraphs.zh: npm run backend # 仅启动后端 npm run frontend # 仅启动前端 选项 2：Docker 部署 # 1. 配置环境变量（与源码部署相同） cp .env.example .env # 2. 拉取镜像并启动 docker compose up -d 默认从根目录读取 .env，映射端口 3000（前端）/ 5001（后端）

sents.en: npm run backend # Start backend only npm run frontend # Start frontend only Option 2: Docker Deployment # 1.
sents.zh: npm run backend # 仅启动后端 npm run frontend # 仅启动前端 选项 2：Docker 部署 # 1.

sents.en: Configure environment variables (same as source deployment) cp .env.example .env # 2.
sents.zh: 配置环境变量（与源码部署相同） cp .env.example .env # 2.

sents.en: Pull image and start docker compose up -d Reads .env from root directory by default, maps ports 3000 (frontend) / 5001 (backend)
sents.zh: 拉取镜像并启动 docker compose up -d 默认从根目录读取 .env，映射端口 3000（前端）/ 5001（后端）

paragraphs.en: Mirror address for faster pulling is provided as comments in docker-compose.yml , replace if needed.
paragraphs.zh: docker-compose.yml 中的注释提供了用于更快拉取的镜像地址，如有需要可自行替换。
